description: International standard for archival description developed by the International Council on Archives (ICA). Defines 26 elements organized in 7 areas for the preparation of archival descriptions applicable to all types of archival material. Based on the principle of multi-level description from the general to the specific.

entities.name: Archival Description
entities.description: A complete archival description following ISAD(G), containing all seven areas of description. May represent any level of archival arrangement from fonds to item.
children: Conditions of Access and Use Area
entities.note: ISAD(G) defines 26 elements in 7 areas. Six elements are essential for international exchange: reference code, title, date(s), level of description, extent and medium, and name of creator(s).

entities.name: Identity Statement Area
entities.description: Area 1 (ISAD 3.1): Information essential to identify the unit of description. Contains 5 elements, all of which are required for international exchange.
entities.note: All five elements in this area are mandatory for multilevel description.

entities.name: Reference Code
entities.description: ISAD 3.1.1: Identify uniquely the unit of description and provide a link to the description that represents it. The reference code should comprise: country code (ISO 3166), repository code, and a specific local reference code, control number, or other unique identifier.
entities.note: REQUIRED. Essential for international exchange. At the highest level, provide the country code, repository code, and a specific reference code.

entities.name: Title
entities.description: ISAD 3.1.2: Name the unit of description. Provide either a formal title or a concise supplied title in accordance with multilevel description rules. If a formal title exists, transcribe it exactly. If not, supply a brief title indicating the creator, nature of the materials, subject/function, or activity.

entities.name: Date
entities.description: ISAD 3.1.3: Identify and record the date(s) of the unit of description. Record the date(s) of creation of the unit of description. For aggregations of records, this may be the dates of accumulation. Identify the type of date(s) given. Record as a single date or range of dates.
entities.note: REQUIRED. Essential for international exchange. Express in ISO 8601 format where possible.

entities.name: Level of Description
entities.description: ISAD 3.1.4: Identify the level of arrangement of the unit of description. Record the level of this unit of description (fonds, sub-fonds, series, sub-series, file, item, or other).

entities.name: Extent and Medium
entities.description: ISAD 3.1.5: Identify and describe the physical or logical extent and the medium of the unit of description. Record the extent in appropriate units (linear shelf space, number of items, etc.) and the medium or media of the unit.
entities.note: REQUIRED. Essential for international exchange. Give quantity, unit, and medium.

entities.name: Context Area
entities.description: Area 2 (ISAD 3.2): Information about the origin and custody of the unit of description. Contains 4 elements recording the provenance and custodial history of the materials.

entities.name: Name of Creator
entities.description: ISAD 3.2.1: Identify the creator(s) of the unit of description. Record the name of the organization(s) or the individual(s) responsible for the creation, accumulation, and maintenance of the records in the unit of description. Use authorised forms of names where available.
entities.note: REQUIRED for international exchange when the name of the creator is not included in the title. Use authorized name forms (e.g., ISAAR(CPF)).

entities.name: Administrative/Biographical History
entities.description: ISAD 3.2.2: Provide an administrative history of, or biographical sketch about, the creator(s) of the unit of description to place the material in context and make it better understood. For a corporate body, record the dates of establishment, legislation, mandate, functions, organizational structure. For a person, record dates, places, occupations, activities, achievements.
entities.note: OPTIONAL. Alternatively, a separate authority record following ISAAR(CPF) may be used.

entities.name: Archival History
entities.description: ISAD 3.2.3: Provide information on the history of the unit of description that is significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation. Record the successive transfers of ownership, responsibility, and/or custody of the unit of description and indicate those actions, such as history of the arrangement, production of contemporary finding aids, re-use of the records for other purposes, or software migrations, that have affected interpretation of the material.

entities.name: Immediate Source of Acquisition
entities.description: ISAD 3.2.4: Identify the immediate source of acquisition or transfer. Record the source from which the unit of description was acquired and the date and/or method of acquisition if any of this information is not confidential.

entities.name: Content and Structure Area
entities.description: Area 3 (ISAD 3.3): Information about the subject matter and arrangement of the unit of description. Contains 4 elements.

entities.name: Scope and Content
entities.description: ISAD 3.3.1: Enable users to judge the potential relevance of the unit of description. Give a summary of the scope (such as time periods, geography) and content (such as documentary forms, subject matter, administrative processes) of the unit of description, appropriate to the level of description.
entities.note: OPTIONAL but strongly recommended at fonds and series levels.

entities.name: Appraisal Destruction and Scheduling
entities.description: ISAD 3.3.2: Provide information on any appraisal, destruction and scheduling action. Record appraisal, destruction and scheduling actions taken on or planned for the unit of description, especially if they may affect the interpretation of the material.

entities.name: Accruals
entities.description: ISAD 3.3.3: Inform the user of anticipated additions to the unit of description. Indicate if accruals are expected. Where appropriate, give an estimate of their quantity and frequency.

entities.name: System of Arrangement
entities.description: ISAD 3.3.4: Provide information on the internal structure, the order and/or the system of classification of the unit of description. Specify the internal structure, ordering and/or classification system. Where appropriate, quote the filing plan of the creator.

entities.name: Conditions of Access and Use Area
entities.description: Area 4 (ISAD 3.4): Information about the availability of the unit of description. Contains 5 elements.

entities.name: Conditions Governing Access
entities.description: ISAD 3.4.1: Provide information about conditions that affect access to the unit of description. Specify the law or legal status, contract, regulation, or policy that affects access. Indicate the extent of the period of closure and the date at which the material will open, where appropriate.
entities.parent: Conditions of Access and Use Area

entities.name: Conditions Governing Reproduction
entities.description: ISAD 3.4.2: Identify any restrictions on reproduction of the unit of description. Give information about conditions, such as copyright, governing reproduction of the unit after access has been provided. If the existence of such conditions is not known, this should be stated.
entities.parent: Conditions of Access and Use Area

entities.name: Language and Scripts of Material
entities.description: ISAD 3.4.3: Identify the language(s), script(s), and symbol systems employed in the unit of description. Record the language(s) and/or script(s) of the materials comprising the unit of description. Note any distinctive alphabets, scripts, symbol systems, or abbreviations employed.
entities.parent: Conditions of Access and Use Area
entities.note: OPTIONAL. Use ISO 639-2 for language codes and ISO 15924 for script codes.

entities.name: Physical Characteristics and Technical Requirements
entities.description: ISAD 3.4.4: Provide information about any important physical characteristics or technical requirements that affect use of the unit of description. Indicate any important physical conditions such as preservation requirements or physical characteristics that affect use, or any software and/or hardware required to access the material.
entities.parent: Conditions of Access and Use Area

entities.name: Finding Aids
entities.description: ISAD 3.4.5: Identify any finding aids to the unit of description. Give information about any finding aids that the repository or the creator of the unit of description may have prepared. If appropriate, publish finding aids or make them available online.
entities.parent: Conditions of Access and Use Area

entities.name: Allied Materials Area
entities.description: Area 5 (ISAD 3.5): Information about materials that have an important relationship to the unit of description. Contains 4 elements.

entities.name: Existence and Location of Originals
entities.description: ISAD 3.5.1: Indicate the existence, location, availability, and/or destruction of originals where the unit of description consists of copies. If the original of the unit of description is available (either in the same repository or elsewhere), record its location together with any significant control numbers.

entities.name: Existence and Location of Copies
entities.description: ISAD 3.5.2: Indicate the existence, location, and availability of copies of the unit of description. If the copy of the unit of description is available (either in the same repository or elsewhere), record its location together with any significant control numbers.

entities.name: Related Units of Description
entities.description: ISAD 3.5.3: Identify related units of description. Record information about units of description in the same repository or elsewhere that are related by provenance or other association(s). Use appropriate introductory wording and explain the nature of the relationship.

entities.name: Publication Note
entities.description: ISAD 3.5.4: Identify any publications that are about or based on the use, study, or analysis of the unit of description. Record a citation to and/or information about any publication based on the use, study, or analysis of the unit of description, including references to published facsimiles or transcriptions.

entities.name: Notes Area
entities.description: Area 6 (ISAD 3.6): Specialized information and information that cannot be accommodated in any of the other areas. Contains 1 element.

entities.name: Note
entities.description: ISAD 3.6.1: Provide information that cannot be accommodated in any of the other areas. Record specialized or other important information not covered elsewhere, such as conservation information, binding information, donor information, or other significant details.

entities.name: Description Control Area
entities.description: Area 7 (ISAD 3.7): Information about how, when, and by whom the archival description was prepared. Contains 3 elements.

entities.name: Archivist Note
entities.description: ISAD 3.7.1: Explain how the description was prepared and by whom. Record notes on sources consulted in preparing the description and who prepared it.

entities.name: Rules or Conventions
entities.description: ISAD 3.7.2: Identify the protocols on which the description is based. Record the international, national, and/or local rules or conventions followed in preparing the description. Record the names and, where useful, the editions or publication dates of the conventions or rules applied.

entities.name: Date of Description
entities.description: ISAD 3.7.3: Indicate when the description was prepared and/or revised. Record the date(s) the description was prepared and/or revised.

entities.name: Access Points
entities.description: Controlled vocabulary terms that provide access to the unit of description. Not part of the 26 core ISAD(G) elements but recommended for discovery. ISAD(G) defers to companion standards for controlled access points.
entities.note: Recommended. Use controlled vocabularies and authority files where available.

entities.name: Subject Access Point
entities.description: Topical term for subject-based discovery of the described materials.

entities.name: Place Access Point
entities.description: Geographic term for place-based discovery of the described materials.

entities.name: Name Access Point
entities.description: Personal, corporate, or family name as a subject access point for discovery.

entities.name: Genre Access Point
entities.description: Form or genre term for documentary type-based discovery of the described materials.

levelsOfDescription.fonds: The whole of the records, regardless of form or medium, organically created and/or accumulated and used by a particular person, family, or corporate body in the course of that creator's activities and functions
levelsOfDescription.sub-fonds: A subdivision of a fonds containing a body of related records corresponding to administrative subdivisions in the originating agency or, when that is not possible, to geographical, chronological, functional, or similar groupings
levelsOfDescription.series: Documents arranged in accordance with a filing system or maintained as a unit because they result from the same accumulation or filing process, or the same activity
levelsOfDescription.file: An organized unit of documents grouped together either for current use by the creator or in the process of archival arrangement, because they relate to the same subject, activity, or transaction
levelsOfDescription.item: The smallest intellectually indivisible archival unit, e.g., a letter, memorandum, report, photograph, sound recording
levelsOfDescription.collection: An artificial accumulation of documents assembled on the basis of some common characteristic without regard to the provenance of those documents

dateTypes.creation: Date(s) when the records were created
dateTypes.accumulation: Date(s) when the records were accumulated over time
dateTypes.bulk: Predominant date range of the majority of materials
dateTypes.inclusive: Earliest and latest dates of the materials

extentUnits.reels: Number of microfilm or tape reels

descriptionAreas.3.4: Conditions of Access and Use Area — Availability (5 elements)
descriptionAreas.3.5: Allied Materials Area — Related materials (4 elements)
descriptionAreas.3.7: Description Control Area — Description provenance (3 elements)

essentialElements.3.1.4: Level of description — REQUIRED for international exchange
essentialElements.3.1.5: Extent and medium of the unit of description — REQUIRED for international exchange
essentialElements.3.2.1: Name of creator(s) — REQUIRED for international exchange if not included in the title
